development_evidence.use: development-only role selection; not confirmatory scoring

primary.rationale: Measured fast/cost-efficient VLM lane with strong table/text metrics; used as the default path so selective recovery has a meaningful cost target.

peer.rationale: Independent non-VLM evidence family. It is used to expose disagreement or source-native constraints, not as a globally superior parser.

strong.rationale: Measured quality-escalation lane on the spent OmniDoc development subset: strongest table TEDS/structure and exact-repeat stability among the recorded candidates, at substantially higher latency/cost.

important_nonclaims: primary does not mean universally best
strong does not mean universally best on every document type
role selection may not be changed after the fresh cohort is opened because of confirmatory outcomes
